source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Record the date, time, and location of the incident.
3. Describe what happened in chronological order, including key details.
4. Identify all individuals involved, including full names, positions, and departments.
5. Document any witnesses to the accident.
6. Capture immediate actions taken after the accident occurred, such as first aid or emergency response.
7. Note any hazardous substances involved or any equipment failure.
8. Collect and attach any photos, CCTV footage, or sketches of the scene.
9. Record the consequences of the accident, including injuries sustained.
10. Document any immediate provisional diagnosis by a medical professional if available.
11. Include statements from anyone involved in or witnessing the incident.
12. Mention any safety measures that were in place at the time and their effectiveness.
13. Report on the steps taken to prevent a recurrence.
14. Complete a risk assessment of the incident.
15. Include the outcome of the investigation, conclusions, and recommended corrective actions
